name: What hidden issues are commonly uncovered after removing a shower?

mainEntity.name: What hidden issues are commonly uncovered after removing a shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Once walls are opened, contractors commonly uncover rotted framing studs, water-damaged subflooring, degraded plumbing pipe fittings, and concealed surface mildew. These issues usually stem from failing grout lines, cracked pan liners, or slow valve leaks over many years. Because HH Remodeling handles custom framing, carpentry, and drywall repair in-house, structural framing repairs or subfloor reinforcements can be addressed immediately before any new waterproofing or finish materials are installed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hidden issues often include rotted wall studs, compromised subflooring, rusted pipe fittings, and moisture accumulation behind old shower pans.
